text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I baked some carrot cookies. Please, have 
one♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, oops, I'm sorry. Craft-chan, you were 
sleeping, weren't you...?!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry. I've been sleeping like 
a log lately, so it takes a lot to wake me 
up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? You must be really 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's really fired up for 
the upcoming Sprinters Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right, you're working hard, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I'll set aside Craft-chan's portion, 
okay? Could you give it to her when she 
wakes up?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much. I'm sure they 
will be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, Craft's really been sleeping a 
lot lately...)
